title: Request Insights: retry clustering & payload playback UX
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design a unified Console lens for failed requests that helps engineers identify root cause and reduce MTTR. Key capabilities: group related failed requests into 'retry clusters', show a compact timeline of attempts, enable payload inspection with schema-aware highlighting, surface an error taxonomy and probable cause hints, and provide safe playback/replay controls for reproducing failures in staging. This ticket covers low-fidelity -> interactive prototype and a cross-functional design review with PM/Eng/Security.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype demonstrates: cluster view, timeline scrubber, payload inspector (JSON/strings), error taxonomy pane, and a lightweight replay control that triggers a safe-stubbed run in staging.
Design spec documents data fetch patterns and privacy filtering for PII-containing payloads.
PM and Eng sign-off on UX trade-offs and lazy-loading strategy to keep console responsive on large payload sets.
Accessibility checks for timeline and payload viewer (keyboard nav + screen reader labels).
design_notes: Primary problem: customers waste time paging through individual failed rows without seeing the relationship between retries and the evolving payload/response.

Retry clusters are derived from a shared correlation_id and similar request fingerprints (same route, similar input schema). We show a compact summary card for each cluster with failure rate, median latency, and last error code.

Payload inspector supports two modes: rendered JSON (collapsible tree, schema hints) and raw text with line numbers. Default view masks high-risk fields (emails, tokens) with reversible blur per user role.

Playback is not a live replay of original traffic; it's a controlled re-run in a staging sandbox using captured sanitized inputs. Initial implementation will surface a 'Request replay (staging only)' CTA that opens a modal with confirmation and audit-note fields.
Performance: lazy-load full payloads and heavy diffs. First paint shows summaries and sample truncated payloads. Full payload fetch occurs on expand or when user enables 'Show full payloads'.
Privacy/security: default PII redaction with configurable allowlists. Security sign-off required before enabling replay for non-staging environments.
Observability links: each cluster and event row includes links to trace ID (OpenTelemetry), logs view, and associated GitHub PRs if referenced by correlation tags.
components: Summary ribbon: top-level KPIs (failed requests, retry clusters, avg time to resolve)
Cluster list: cards grouped by fingerprint with quick filters (recent regressions, high-severity)
Timeline scrubber: visualize attempt times, hover to preview payload snapshot and response status
Payload inspector: JSON tree + raw pane + side-by-side diff between first attempt and last attempt
Error taxonomy pane: hierarchical view (network, model-timeout, 4xx client, schema-mismatch, throttling) with suggested next steps
Replay modal: staging re-run options, sanitized input preview, audit note, and run history
engineering_feedback: ENG feedback (2025-02-12): prefer server-side clustering; frontend should only request pre-aggregated clusters to avoid N^2 queries on large result sets.
ENG (2025-02-14): lazy-load payloads and diffs; propose a 'payload preview' API that returns truncated JSON and schema hints.
ENG (2025-02-16): replay should not ship until replay sandbox and audit logging exist. For prototype, simulate replay without invoking production runtime.
pm_feedback: PM note (2025-02-13): prioritize 'retry cluster' UX and timeline scrubber for the first pass; full diffing can be v2.
PM ask: capture user actions for analytics (which clusters are inspected, replays triggered) to validate ROI.
security_review: Security flagged: PII redaction is mandatory in default mode; any opt-in to show raw payloads must require RBAC permission and an audit event.
Decision: implement masking ruleset in the console and require a feature flag (security-approved) for unmasking.
design_decisions: Decision 1: show cluster-first view (grouping at index time) to reduce cognitive load.
Decision 2: default to masked payloads with a reversible blur for users who pass RBAC checks.
Decision 3: implement diffs only on demand (costly) — show first/last attempt side-by-side when user requests 'Compare attempts'.

notes_for_implementation: Frontend: use virtualization for cluster list, skeleton loaders for payloads.
Backend: pre-compute fingerprint and cluster_id during ingest; provide a paginated cluster API.
Telemetry: record cluster_id, action, user_role, and whether redaction was toggled.
Docs: add a 'How to troubleshoot failed requests' guide linking this Console lens and common remediation steps.
final_comment: This ticket is focused on delivering a prototype and finalizing the data contract with Eng. Once we have sign-off on protocols and security constraints, follow-up tickets will split implementation across clusters API, payload preview, and replay sandbox integration.
